name: Stupefied
note: Reference text: the ruleset defines how conditions work (rulesets/pf2e/rules.js).
text: Your thoughts and instincts are clouded. Stupefied always includes a value. You take a status penalty equal to this value on Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based rolls and DCs, including Will saving throws, spell attack modifiers, spell DCs, and skill checks that use these attribute modifiers. Any time you attempt to Cast a Spell while stupefied, the spell is disrupted unless you succeed at a DC resolve(5+@item.badge.value) Flat check with a DC equal to 5 + your stupefied value.
